name: Eclipse Telecommunications
summary: Sydney data communications / frame-relay provider (from 1996, ~100 business customers); acquired by Primus Telecommunications Group in Apr 1998 (~$2.5m) (ECLIPSE TELECOMMUNICATIONS PTY. LTD., ACN 069 554 383).

events.details: Sydney-based data communications provider operating from early 1996 (~100 business customers, $4m annualised revenue, switches/PoPs in 5 capitals).
Acquired by Primus Telecommunications Group Inc, announced 6 Apr 1998 (~$2.5m cash + 27,500 Primus shares); became Primus data division.
